children: ARK bought 243,707 NVDA shares (~$53–55.6M) after NVIDIA reported Q2: revenue $96.2B (+106% YoY), Data Center $89B (+117%), non-GAAP EPS $2.22, guidance ~$108B.
NVIDIA invested $3.5B in MediaTek convertible bonds to expand AI, local computing and automotive ties, grant NVLink Fusion use, and advance joint products like RTX Spark and DGX Spark.
NVIDIA backs a $35B Anthropic cloud deal. NVDA holds the lease on a Nueces County, Texas data center where Lambda will deploy NVIDIA chips to add ~350 MW capacity for Claude AI.
U.S. export rules bar NVIDIA (NVDA) from selling top AI chips to China but permit robotics and automotive chips; China remains a key market, affecting NVDA’s supply chain and global AI ops.
NVIDIA says its ~$500B AI financing program funds AI infrastructure, not circular demand. CEO Jensen Huang and CFO Colette Kress say OpenAI will pay the Ohio data center lease.
NVIDIA (NVDA) revived the Rubin CPX accelerator with a redesigned architecture and plans production start in Q1 2027, signaling the program's return to its AI roadmap.
Analyst Ming‑Chi Kuo says a partnership lets MediaTek expand into rack‑scale systems and helps NVIDIA extend its rack‑scale ecosystem into the custom‑silicon market, relevant for NVDA traders.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said Nvidia isn’t worried by custom AI chips, arguing GPUs stay versatile for many AI tasks and Nvidia is working to link specialized processors to its systems.
